title: Weld Tech Group - Installation of Process Pipelines
meta_description: Professional welding and installation of steel pipelines (TIG, orbital, MIG-MAG, MMA). Full cycle: from design to testing.
main_description: We professionally install and weld process pipelines made of stainless steel (AISI-304L, AISI-308L, AISI-316L, AISI-321), carbon steel (St.20, 30), as well as titanium and aluminum.

tig.title: Manual welding in argon atmosphere (WIG – TIG)

orbital.title: Orbital welding (WIG – TIG)
orbital.diameter: Pipe diameter: from 20 mm to 115 mm

mma.title: MMA and MIG–MAG
mma.description: Used for working with pipe walls over 8 mm (with prior edge preparation and multilayer filling).

thin.title: Up to 2.6 mm (AISI-304L, AISI-316L, AISI-321)
thin.description: "Pendel" method without the use of filler material (WIG–TIG).

medium.title: Over 2.6 mm
medium.description: Welding of dividing grooves using filler material (WIG–TIG).

thick.title: Over 8 mm
thick.description: Additionally, MMA or MIG–MAG is used (with edge preparation and multilayer welding).

bottom_description: This combined method provides advantages in quality, speed, and costs. We perform the entire range of associated works: design, cutting, pipe preparation, valve installation, verification, and testing of pipeline systems.

realisations.title: Our Realizations
realisations.description: Each of our projects reflects exact fulfillment of customer requirements, a well-thought-out economic model, and impeccable technical execution.
